question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Vacant
solution:
The correct answer is: **Empty**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Vacant"** means not filled or occupied; available to be used or taken. (खाली)

 
 
• **Example: **The house has been vacant for months, awaiting new tenants.
 
 
 
• **"Empty"** refers to containing nothing; not filled or occupied. (खाली)
 
 
• **Example: **The room was empty, with no furniture or decorations.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Vacant'** is **'Empty'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 (Empty)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Brutal **(निर्दयी): Savagely violent or cruel.

 
 
• **Example:** The dictator's brutal regime caused immense suffering to the people.
 
 
 
• **Full **(पूर्ण): Containing or holding as much or as many as possible; having no empty space.
 
 
• **Example: **The glass is full of water, so be careful not to spill it.
 
 
 
• **Popular** (लोकप्रिय): Liked or admired by many people or by a particular person or group.
 
 
• **Example:** The singer is very popular among teenagers.
